correctness.rationale: The 1-overlap constraint makes every nonempty code choose a common first bit and opposite final bit; complement reduces to starting 0/ending 1. The four eligible 3-prefixes 000,001,010,011 have nested 3-suffix neighborhoods of sizes 4,3,2,1. Any code is contained in the rectangle for its largest occurring prefix, all rectangles valid for disjoint boundaries n>=6, and a weight-w slice contains coefficient of (1+z)^(n-6) H_j(z) yielding the four binomial expressions. Complement swaps orientations; coefficient asymptotics and exact adjacent crossings give all three density transitions. Independent code enumerated all 255 nonempty subsets of three-bit prefixes at 132 (n,w) pairs n=6..16 and matched the formula; logical nesting proof applies at every n>=6.
residual_risks: n>=6 essential because boundary three-blocks must not overlap.
